the innovation strategy of manufacturing companies is an important determinant of their financial performance.

innovation strategy is an important determinant of company financial results and that a company's desired level of innovation leadership orientation, its use of external sources of innovation, and its intensity in investing in innovation are all important determinants of its financial performance.
